decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already records the fresh token sequence, active-replacement-contract scope, and exclusion of old-contract referral identities; no additional update or removal is required.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits referral, ticket, and payout reporting to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract data; no stale attribute remains.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts random-owner selection to NFTs from the active replacement contract and explicitly excludes old-contract owners.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that Transak-originated mints target the active replacement contract only; no incompatible prior contract-scope key remains.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that ETH wallet mints target the active replacement contract only; no additional update or removal is necessary.
